prompt:
Create ONE scroll-stopping vertical video cover (thumbnail), 9:16 portrait, for a short Malay video about a young person who stops traffic to help an elderly man cross a busy road while everyone else drives past.

The attached image is ONLY a style and character reference: keep the same pure-white minimalist stick-figure characters (a tall young figure with a soft white glow, and a smaller hunched elderly figure with a walking cane) and the dark cinematic night look. Do NOT copy its composition, camera angle or layout. Make a completely new, more dramatic and creative scene.

CONCEPT (the hook is tension): extreme low camera angle, almost at road level, looking straight at a huge oncoming car. Its two giant blinding headlights glare out of the darkness and flood the frame with white light and long light rays, with more headlights stacked behind it in the distance. In the middle of the road, tiny against the glare, stand the hunched elderly figure with his cane and the glowing young figure right beside him. The young figure holds one palm up like a shield, and the light rays visibly bend and stop at his hand. A thin glowing red thread connects the young figure's other hand to the old man's hand, the only red in the picture apart from the headline. Wet glossy asphalt reflects the lights and the figures. Strong silhouettes, deep blacks, high contrast, cinematic, emotional and slightly scary but heart-warming. The two characters must be clearly readable and not too small.

HEADLINE TEXT (the only text in the image, in Malay, written EXACTLY with this spelling, ultra-bold heavy sans-serif, huge, centred in the upper third inside safe margins so nothing is cut off, heavy black outline so it stays readable on a phone):
Line 1: TIADA SIAPA BERHENTI...  (pure white)
Line 2: KECUALI DIA.  (vivid red #ff2d4a with a soft red glow, noticeably larger than line 1)
Keep the headline above the glare so the letters stay crisp and readable.

Do NOT add any other text, labels, captions, logos, watermarks, borders or UI elements.
